papers.title: CANNBot-CAKE: Collaborative Agentic Kernel Evolution for Ascend NPU
papers.abstract: Efficient custom operators are essential for modern deep learning workloads, yet developing high-performance kernels for Ascend NPUs remains slow, expert-intensive, and difficult to automate. Although AI agents now approach expert performance on GPU kernel benchmarks, current models remain less capable of generating AscendC kernels for NPUs, potentially reflecting the relative scarcity of relevant training data. We thus present CAKE, a CANN-native system for deployable custom operators that combines adaptive multi-DSL routing, separate Generation and Evolution modes, and reviewed knowledge reuse through CAKE Book and a Self-Evolving Agent. On 53 CANN-Bench v1.1 operators on Ascend 950PR, CAKE's aggregated results achieve $100\%$ case pass rate on the standard set (1,060/1,060) and $98.28\%$ on the hidden set (4,167/4,240), with an overall mean score of 78.63 out of 100 and an average performance speedup of $1.334\times$ over the baseline. Evolution then pushes correct operators further: EngramGateFusion cuts aggregate device time by $46.6\%$ over 20 rounds and roughly halves the mean roofline gap. These results offer a practical path toward closing Ascend's AI-for-kernel capability gap.

papers.title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
papers.abstract: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months. To improve SSD lifetime, a natural solution is to reduce the KV cache writes by gating the KV cache writes via historical access patterns. However, that significantly lowers the KV cache hit rate (and increase the LLM serving cost) since KV caches from different attention types might have identical historical access pattern but different future access patterns. Our insight is that, to reduce KV cache writes without hurting KV cache hit rate, one need to not only consider the access pattern, but also application-level information such as the attention type of KV cache. Leveraging this observation, we propose Gandalf , the first SSD KV cache offloading system with SSD life time awareness. Gandalf prioritize the admission of full-attention KV cache into SSD over the cache generated by other types of attention, which significantly increases SSD lifetime without sacrificing cache hit rate. Our evaluation shows that Gandalf extends the SSD lifetime by 7.3X on average, while having negligible impact on cache hit rate across multiple workload traces and wide range of hardware capacity. Gandalf design can be extended to other flash-based storage, such as High Bandwidth Flash (HBF).

papers.title_zh: 甘道夫：闪存永生！提升 LLM 服务中 KV Cache 卸载场景下的闪存寿命
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出，在多轮对话与 LLM Agent 等生产负载下，卸载到 SSD 的 KV Cache 写入总量会远超 SSD 容量，使闪存寿命从数年缩短到数月。作者发现，仅依赖历史访问模式来限制 KV Cache 写入，会同时拦截不同注意力类型但历史访问模式相同的 KV Cache，导致缓存命中率明显下降；为此提出 Gandalf，这是首个具备 SSD 寿命感知能力的 KV Cache 卸载系统，利用注意力类型这一应用层信息，优先写入 full-attention 的 KV Cache，把其他注意力类型产生的 KV Cache 排在后面。在多组负载 trace 和较宽的硬件容量范围内评测，Gandalf 平均把 SSD 寿命延长 7.3 倍，同时对缓存命中率的影响可以忽略。
innovations: 提出 Gandalf，首个带 SSD 寿命感知的 KV Cache 卸载系统；它把 full-attention KV Cache 与其他注意力类型（如滑动窗口、稀疏注意力）产生的 KV Cache 区分开，优先写入前者。
揭示现有写入门控方案失效的根本原因：不同注意力类型的 KV Cache 可能具有相同的历史访问模式，却有不同的未来访问模式；仅凭访问模式做准入判断会让命中率与寿命相互冲突。
将应用层注意力类型信息引入闪存写入准入决策，在不牺牲 KV Cache 命中率的前提下显著压缩写入量，平均延长 SSD 寿命 7.3 倍。
该设计可推广到 High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) 等其他基于闪存的存储介质，为 KV Cache 分层存储给出了寿命维度的新优化目标。
papers.scenario_cn: 解决 LLM 推理服务中 KV Cache 卸载到 SSD 后因写入量过大导致闪存提前报废的运维与成本问题，适用于多轮对话、Agent 类长会话的高并发在线推理系统，以及需要以 SSD/HBF 扩展 KV Cache 容量的分层存储部署。

papers.title: IRAH: Hierarchical Agentic Tree Search for Retrieval Pipeline Optimization
papers.abstract: Optimizing Information Retrieval (IR) pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) requires jointly selecting structural components and numerical hyperparameters under limited evaluation budgets. We introduce the Information Retrieval Agentic Harness (IRAH), which combines Language Agent Tree Search for IR (LATS-IR) with offline meta-learned initialization. LATS-IR performs UCT-guided hierarchical search, first exploring macro-structural pipeline choices and then refining numerical parameters, with natural-language reflections to guide subsequent mutations and provide inspectable search traces. We evaluate IRAH on three in-distribution benchmarks and one out of-distribution benchmark to assess generalization under distribution shift. Under the same meta-learned initialization, LATS-IR outperforms TPE on two of three in-distribution benchmarks, with gains of up to 6.4%, and remains competitive on the out-of-distribution benchmark. Across all four benchmarks, warm-started IRAH achieves the highest average held-out nDCG@10 (0.4816) and improves over its cold-start counterpart. These results establish IRAH as a competitive approach to retrieval pipeline optimization under constrained evaluation budgets.

papers.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and all-step baselines at substantially lower cost. These results demonstrate that selective candidate sampling and lightweight verification provide complementary gains in coding-agent performance and inference efficiency. Our model, code, and data are available at this https URL .

papers.title_zh: SWE-VERIFIER：面向低成本编码智能体的选择性验证

设计训练数据构造方式：以 Qwen3.5-4B 为底座，用成组对比动作、其执行后的环境观测以及 rubric 指导的教师评分构建偏好数据训练验证器。
在 mini-swe-agent 上使 MiniMax-M2.7 解决率从 75.47% 升至 77.20%（1.09 倍成本），并零训练迁移到 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，从 72.60% 升至 74.27%（1.13 倍成本），显示跨模型泛化能力。

papers.title: ProQuant: Preserving Expert Quality over Quantity in Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models reduce computation through sparse activation but still incur substantial storage costs. Mixed-precision post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces these costs by quantizing different model components at different bit widths, but existing methods often struggle to preserve generation quality under tight bit budgets. We identify two key challenges: (1) nonlinear quantization errors at extremely low precision are underestimated when cross-layer propagation is ignored; (2) direct router fine-tuning may cause routing drift, and calibration gains may not generalize to downstream tasks. To address these issues, we propose ProQuant, a weight-only PTQ framework for MoE models. Prune-or-Prioritize Mixed-Precision Allocation (PoP) jointly optimizes expert pruning and bit-width assignment. It allows higher-precision experts to substitute for severely degraded ones while improving bit-budget utilization. Routing-Consistent RMSNorm Finetune (RoCo) adapts expert input representations through mathematically equivalent transformations. It compensates for quantization errors to reduce routing drift. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProQuant outperforms existing methods across diverse generative tasks. Code is available at this https URL .

papers.title_zh: ProQuant：在混合专家模型的超低比特量化中守住专家质量而非数量
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对 MoE 大模型在混合精度训练后量化（PTQ）中紧比特预算下生成质量骤降的问题，归纳出两个关键症结：一是极低精度下的非线性量化误差在忽略跨层传播时被低估，二是直接微调路由器会引发路由漂移，而且校准集上的收益未必能泛化到下游任务。为此提出 ProQuant 这一 weight-only PTQ 框架，其中 PoP（Prune-or-Prioritize Mixed-Precision Allocation）联合优化专家剪枝与比特宽度分配，允许用高精度专家替补退化严重的专家，从而提高比特预算利用率；RoCo（Routing-Consistent RMSNorm Finetune）通过数学等价变换调整专家输入表示，补偿量化误差以抑制路由漂移。在多种生成任务上，ProQuant 优于现有方法，代码已开源。
innovations: ProQuant 框架同时处理跨层误差传播与路由稳定性两个问题，区别于只做逐层或逐专家误差最小化的常规混合精度 PTQ。
PoP 把专家剪枝和比特宽度分配放进同一个优化中联合求解，使高精度专家可以替代严重退化的专家，把有限的比特预算花在真正关键的专家上。
RoCo 用数学等价变换改写 RMSNorm，在不改变原模型函数的前提下适配专家输入表示，从而补偿量化误差、降低路由漂移，避免直接微调 router 带来的校准收益不泛化问题。
在紧比特预算的超低比特设置下，于多种生成任务上取得优于现有 MoE 量化方法的生成质量，并公开了代码。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向显存与存储受限环境下 MoE 大模型的低成本部署，解决超低比特量化后专家退化、路由错乱导致生成质量崩坏的问题，适用于需要把大规模 MoE 模型压缩后上线推理服务的场景。

papers.title: Conflict-Aware Logit Adapters for Utility-Preserving Anti-Distillation
papers.abstract: While reasoning traces improve model capability, they also provide supervision signals for downstream distillation. Initial efforts to mitigate this issue rely on decoding-time interventions, but they incur high inference overhead and can harm the teacher model's natural fluency. We propose Conflict-Aware Logit Adapters (CALA), a lightweight training-time defense. CALA attaches a small residual adapter to a frozen teacher model and trains only the adapter. A proxy student identifies positions where imitation is most sensitive, and the adapter perturbs the output distribution at these positions while remaining within high-probability regions. A conflict-aware optimization strategy balances anti-distillation and utility objectives, while regularization preserves the teacher's performance and fluency. At inference time, CALA incurs modest overhead and requires no auxiliary model. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that CALA substantially reduces successful student imitation while maintaining near-original teacher performance and generation quality. These results establish CALA as a practical and efficient alternative to decoding-time approaches.

papers.title: A Transformer-based Approach for Real-time Multi-agent Path Planning with Varying Initial/Final Conditions
papers.abstract: We address the problem of real-time multi-agent path planning under prescribed initial and final configurations, formulated as a high-dimensional optimal control problem subject to inter-agent collision avoidance and obstacle constraints. Classical solvers based on the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation or Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) become computationally intractable as the number of agents grows, due to the curse of dimensionality and the non-convexity introduced by interaction constraints. We propose OCFormer, a transformer-based neural network that parameterizes the inverse of a coordinate transformation mapping a simple, analytically tractable latent space, in which agents evolve independently under a decoupled Hamiltonian, to the physical space of the coupled, interacting system. The model is trained by minimizing a physics-informed loss comprising the Hamiltonian ODE residual from the PMP and a boundary matching term, without requiring pre-computed trajectory data. The self-attention mechanism endows OCFormer with permutation equivariance over agents, a structural symmetry that prior symplectic network approaches do not natively enforce. When trained on a distribution of boundary conditions, the amortized OCFormer produces near-optimal trajectories for unseen initial and final configurations in a single forward pass ($\sim$220ms), enabling real-time inference without retraining. We further introduce a lightweight transfer learning framework that adapts a pretrained OCFormer to out-of-distribution perturbations in seconds via L-BFGS fine-tuning. Numerical experiments on two- and three-dimensional multi-agent navigation with up to 128 agents demonstrate the scalability and efficiency of the proposed approach.

papers.title: Where Did the Light Come From? Diagnosing Cast-Shadow Reasoning in VLMs and Borrowing the Missing Shadow Prior from Image Generation Models
papers.abstract: Shadows are observable consequences of latent physical causes, arising from the interaction between illumination, object geometry, and scene structure. A model that understands shadows should be able not only to read a shadow's direction, but also to infer where a shadow should fall when it is absent, and to judge whether a shadow is physically consistent with the scene. We introduce ShadowBench, built from real photographs, which poses these three questions to vision-language models (VLMs). From each scene, we build a correct-shadow, a shadow-removed, and a human-annotated wrong-direction state. Evaluating 19 open VLMs (2B to 78B) and frontier proprietary models, we find that VLMs read a visible shadow's direction well above chance and improve with scale, yet infer the absent direction only weakly and fall to chance at judging physical consistency even under a bias-free two-alternative test that removes the yes-bias of single-image naturalness questions. Only Gemini-3.1-pro exceeds chance on validity, and even then only modestly and far below humans. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) does not help. The missing ingredient is not reasoning but knowledge that image generation models (IGMs) already hold. Routing a VLM through an IGM lifts its inference well above its direct attempt and helps it flag the wrong-direction shadows it otherwise accepts. Cast-shadow direction is a single facet of illumination understanding, but the sharp gap it reveals between VLMs and IGMs suggests image-generation or reconstruction objectives as a route toward illumination-aware VLMs.

papers.summary_cn: 论文提出 ShadowBench：该基准全部取材于真实照片，为每个场景构造“正确阴影 / 移除阴影 / 人工标注错误方向”三种状态，把阴影理解拆成读取可见阴影方向、推断缺失阴影应落在何处、判断阴影与场景是否物理一致三个问题。作者评测了 19 个 2B–78B 开源 VLM 与前沿闭源模型，发现模型读取可见阴影方向显著高于随机且随规模提升，但推断缺失阴影方向的能力很弱；在消除是/否偏置的二选一测试中，物理一致性判断降到随机水平，仅 Gemini-3.1-pro 略微超过随机且远低于人类，链式思维（CoT）也无帮助。作者据此指出缺的不是推理而是图像生成模型（IGM）已掌握的阴影先验，将 VLM 经由 IGM 路由后，缺失方向推断明显超过其直接作答，并能识别原本被接受的错误方向阴影。

papers.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.

papers.title_zh: 面向思维剪枝的直接 Pass@$k$ 优化：在测试时推理中平衡质量与多样性
papers.summary_cn: 测试时扩展让推理模型大量采样候选解，以期至少命中一个正确答案，但把每个候选都完整求解的代价高昂；现有做法是只生成较短的前缀，就裁剪候选池，其中质量型方法按得分淘汰、多样性型方法按轨迹差异保留，这本质上是探索与利用的权衡，却几乎没有工作直接优化它。作者提出直接以 pass@$k$ 为目标的剪枝流程：在给定保留数量下，选择这样的子集——使“池中至少一个部分解续写后能得到正确答案”的概率最大；由此让质量与多样性由同一准则自然平衡，而不依赖额外的启发式设计。在八个开源权重推理模型上，该方法优于现有的质量型与多样性型剪枝策略；当剪枝后保留中等数量的部分解继续生成时，增益最为明显。
innovations: 把思维剪枝显式建模为对候选池的 pass@$k$ 最大化：按“至少一个部分解续写后正确”的概率挑选子集，让质量与多样性在同一目标内同时优化，而不是靠分开的启发式规则拼接。
剪枝准则自身就会惩罚冗余：高质量的部分解被奖励，彼此重复的推理轨迹被抑制，无需额外设计多样性惩罚项或聚类步骤。
在八个开源权重推理模型上系统对比质量型与多样性型剪枝基线并取得更优结果，同时发现保留中等规模的候选池（而不是保留得极少或极多）时收益最大。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于需要“大量采样再筛选”的推理模型部署，例如数学与逻辑题求解、代码生成的测试时扩展：先用较短的前缀淘汰大部分候选，只对少数部分解继续生成，从而在同等算力和显存预算下提高至少命中一个正确答案的概率。

papers.title: Edit, Don't Imitate: Minimal-Edit On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfers to external mathematics and perception benchmarks. Because the minimal-edit teacher evaluates corrections rather than generating its own solution, the method remains effective with a frozen same-size teacher, although its gains are smaller than with a larger teacher on most metrics.

papers.title_zh: 编辑而非模仿：面向多模态推理的最小编辑同策略蒸馏
papers.summary_cn: 视觉数学推理常常在推理开始前就已经失败：视觉语言模型误读图形后，后续推理便建立在错误前提上；这种感知瓶颈在小模型上尤其突出，而准确的文本图形描述能显著缩小它和大模型之间的差距，可是要在推理时获得这类描述，就需要额外标注或模型调用。作者提出最小编辑纠正式同策略蒸馏（minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation）：训练阶段只把参考图形描述和已验证的参考解作为训练期信息；教师按最小编辑目标给学生的错误 rollout 打分，只有教师不认可的 token 才计入纠正损失；正确的 rollout 则用任务奖励做强化学习。该方法保留了同策略监督，同时避免整段回答的模仿；推理时不需要任何图形描述，在多个模型规模上达到或超过“推理时额外提供参考图形描述”的基座模型，并提升感知导向任务（尤其是低层几何感知任务）的表现，还能迁移到外部数学与感知基准；因为教师只评估纠正、不自行生成解答，同尺寸的冻结教师同样有效，只是在多数指标上增益小于更大的教师。
innovations: 最小编辑纠正式同策略蒸馏：教师借助参考图形描述与已验证参考解，只对学生的错误 rollout 按“最小编辑”评分，只让教师判为不可取的 token 进入纠正损失，正确的 rollout 则走任务奖励强化学习，从而在不做全响应模仿的前提下保留同策略监督。
把感知信息前置到训练阶段：参考描述只作训练信号，测试时不需要额外标注，也不需要额外模型调用，却在多个模型规模上追平或超过推理时附带参考图形描述的基座模型。
在低层几何感知等感知导向指标上提升显著，并能迁移到外部数学与视觉感知基准；同时验证了教师只需评估纠正、无需生成解答，同尺寸的冻结教师即可生效（虽然增益小于更大的教师）。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向需要读图解题的多模态应用，例如几何题与图表题的解题助手，以及小模型的低成本部署：用现成的图文描述与标准答案构造纠正信号并完成训练后，上线时无需额外视觉标注或多次模型调用，即可减少因误读图形而导致的整条推理链错误。

papers.title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
papers.abstract: Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. papers.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
papers.abstract: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT's use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control, paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.

papers.title: Certified Execution Harness for Agentic AI: Safe and Least-Intrusive Petri-Net Supervisory Control Between Reasoning and Action
papers.abstract: This paper studies the problem of safe tool execution for large language model (LLM) agents under prompt injection. Using Petri nets, we formalize the execution harness between the LLM and its tools as a supervisory control problem, in which marks represent capabilities, approvals and budgets. Since a transition fires only if the marks it needs are present, an injected request whose preconditions are unmet or already spent is refused regardless of its wording. Treating tool outcomes as uncontrollable, we enforce safety by the conventional maximally permissive supervisor, and this safety transfers to the running system under four assumptions. Moreover, to capture an agent that may propose again after a refusal, we introduce the notion of a replanning closed loop, in which each retry costs an inference call. We show that, in this loop, the conventional supervisor can be arbitrarily more intrusive than a stricter safe one. Furthermore, for a given proposer model, the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor is characterized as a value-threshold refinement of the conventional one. Under precise conditions, this refinement orders two concurrent actions by at most one monitor place. On an autonomous release agent, we find by synthesis that safe deployment requires a step that the supervisor can refuse after a rollout starts.

papers.title: Amplifying Latency and Cost of LLM Inference via Rowhammer Attack
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high inference efficiency using optimized GPU kernels generated by just-in-time (JIT) compilation frameworks such as Triton. Triton compiles GPU kernels through an MLIR/LLVM-based pipeline. We investigate whether a Rowhammer-induced bit-flip in the CPU's DRAM can degrade GPU-based LLM inference performance while preserving output correctness. We present LLVMhammer, the first Rowhammer attack that causes LLM inference slowdown by inducing a bit-flip in Triton's compilation pipeline. A bit-flip in a performance-critical optimization pass causes Triton to generate a functionally identical but suboptimal GPU kernel. Since Triton caches the generated kernel on disk, a single successful bit-flip causes persistent slowdown across subsequent inference executions. Triton's target-independent stages are shared across GPU vendors, which makes our attack GPU vendor-agnostic. To identify exploitable bit-flip locations without manual inspection, we build Karnage, a tool that isolates useful bit-flip locations in Triton's target-independent compilation pipeline. We evaluate LLVMHammer across a diverse set of LLMs, including Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Deepseek-llm-7B-chat, across NVIDIA RTX 4090 and AMD RX 7900 XTX GPUs. LLVMhammer increases inference latency of an LLM inference server running on a single GPU by 4-16\%, which, in turn, can translate into additional annual operating costs at the scale of multi-GPU deployments. We further show that LLVMhammer can also corrupt LLM outputs across different GPU vendors, reducing BERTScore to as low as 25\%, illustrating the broader security implications of bit-flips in Triton's compilation pipeline.

papers.title: Anomaly Score Preserving Data Poisoning Attacks on Data-Driven Controller Design
papers.abstract: This paper investigates stealthy data poisoning attacks against data-driven controller synthesis and develops an attack generation method. During data collection, an attacker can sequentially manipulate state measurements, while the defender attempts to detect such manipulation using a residual-based anomaly score based on the Mahalanobis distance. Under suitable assumptions on the defender's prior knowledge, we characterize the class of time-varying affine transformations that preserve the anomaly score for arbitrary data and parameterize this class by the orthogonal group. Based on this characterization, we formulate attack design under the stealthiness condition as an optimization problem over the orthogonal group and propose a Riemannian gradient method. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed attack can degrade closed-loop performance while remaining stealthy.

papers.title: Detection Is Not Enough: Reasoning Traces as Testable Program Hypotheses
papers.abstract: When a language model is deployed, no reference solution exists, so the reasoning trace it writes is the only evidence for judging its answer. The reference-free substitutes each fail differently: self-assessment degrades the answer it was meant to protect, sampling agreement measures stability rather than correctness, and perturbation studies read the expected answer off a human-written template, grading a model rather than a trace. We ask how far a single trace can be verified with no reference solution, no judge model and no weight update, and find, for a frozen LLaMA-2-7B-chat on GSM8K, that detection is not what limits such a pipeline. Checking a trace against itself reaches an AUROC of 0.741 and stops there for a structural reason: two thirds of wrong traces state no false equation, having executed a mistaken plan correctly, and on wrong-plan failures the detector flags a wrong trace less often than a right one. A candidate-derived metamorphic probe exposes many of these failures: we abstract the trace into a program over the question's quantities, perturb one quantity, execute the program, and ask the model the rewritten question once, so every trace supplies its own test. Valid perturbations exist for 937 of 1,319 test questions (71.0%); among the 847 that also have a parseable first trace, supported traces are correct 60.6% of the time against a 31.6% base rate, although the probe also refutes 45.5% of correct traces. No tested policy yields a statistically significant improvement in accuracy. A flag earns its retry only when detector precision exceeds D/(R+D), where R and D are the rates at which a retry repairs a wrong trace and damages a correct one; our repair rate is so low that, at the same retry budget, even a perfect detector would recover an estimated 66 of 1,319 questions. Repair, not detection, is the open problem.

papers.title: FIGFLEX: A Mixed-Precision FP-INT GEMM Accelerator Co-Designed with Low-Bit LLM Quantization
papers.abstract: Weight-only quantization keeps LLM activations in floating point and stores weights as low-bit integers, turning the dominant workload into floating-point-integer (FP-INT) general matrix multiplication. Recent quantizers reach a 2-3-bit average with mixed precision, but hardware has not kept pace: GPUs dequantize weights to FP16 before the tensor-core multiply-accumulate, and bit-parallel FP-INT accelerators run at a single weight precision, so fewer bits save memory but not computation. In this paper, we present FIGFLEX, an algorithm-hardware co-designed mixed-precision accelerator whose bit-parallel datapath scales throughput as precision falls. FIGFLEX contributes (1) a shift-add, radix-4 reformulation of FP-INT multiplication that fuses the multiply-accumulate into a unified, precision-flexible partial-product reduction and roughly halves the partial products, together with a novel INT3 optimization that reclaims the idle datapath radix-4 leaves at that precision; and (2) a mixed-precision quantizer that assigns each channel group its bit-width according to the error GPTQ cannot compensate, with a per-input-channel column scaling whose power-of-two normalization keeps the scaled activations out of the FP16 subnormal range, so that the quantized model maps directly onto FIGFLEX's datapath with the same accuracy as on a GPU. On LLaMA-2-7B, FIGFLEX attains 5.85 and 8.77 WikiText-2 perplexity at 3- and 2-bit average precision, lower than GPTQ, AWQ, SliM-LLM, AMQ, and QuIP# (without fine-tuning), while delivering 1.56x and 1.42x higher whole-chip throughput per area on the linear GEMMs of a 3-bit mixed-precision model than AxCore and FIGLUT, respectively.

papers.title: Direct Forcing: A Single-Stage Training Recipe for Few-Step Autoregressive Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables low-latency streaming, yet prevailing training pipelines separate causal adaptation from distribution matching. Recent representation-based text-to-video methods retain this separation by starting from ODE-initialized checkpoints, even when the target distribution is defined directly by reference videos. We introduce Direct Forcing, a single-stage framework that uses reference videos both as paired examples of how a history continues and as a target population for self-generated rollouts. Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired spatiotemporal correspondence under reference histories, while Rollout Distribution Matching uses maximum mean discrepancy to align the representation distributions of self-generated and reference videos. Together, these complementary signals allow a pretrained video model to learn causal continuation and the target video distribution in a single training stage. Dynamic Gradient Balancing adapts the relative gradient contributions of continuation alignment and distribution matching during training. Starting from bidirectional Wan2.1-1.3B, Direct Forcing learns a four-step autoregressive generator in 250 updates without a separate initialization stage or online diffusion-score supervision, achieving 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality. Ablation studies further demonstrate the benefits of dynamic gradient balancing and reveal distinct representation preferences: deeper features benefit continuation alignment, whereas intermediate features yield better performance for rollout distribution matching.

papers.title: MoG-VLM: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection through Motion-Guided Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. A fusion module then reconciles these instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Across four benchmarks, our method achieves 91.91%, 84.30%, 87.88%, and 78.96% AUC-ROC on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, and ShanghaiTech, respectively, establishing new state of the art on three benchmarks under the zero-shot, training-free setting. On XD-Violence, we improve over the previous best result by +0.57% while delivering a 1.31x inference speedup. These results demonstrate that content-aware allocation of VLM capacity, processing fewer frames more intelligently rather than all frames uniformly, is a more effective axis of progress than uniformly densifying VLM inference across frames. papers.title: TRACE: Traversability-aware Reactive Navigation via VLM-driven Adaptive Constraints Estimation
papers.abstract: This paper presents TRACE, a traversability-aware reactive navigation framework designed for the autonomous operation of ground robots in unstructured forest environments. Unlike traditional approaches, TRACE leverages VLM-based confidence maps from positive and negative natural-language prompt sets and combines them through evidential fusion to produce a dense traversability map that prioritizes the terrain based on signs of previously traversed paths. Traversability-annotated points are then extracted and used to derive the left and right boundaries of the traversable path via percentile binning followed by spline or regularized polynomial fitting. These boundaries are then incorporated as soft barrier constraints within an NMPC formulation, enabling safe and adaptive path following in complex natural environments. Rigorous experimental trials carried out in real-life forest environments demonstrate TRACE ability for smooth navigation in cluttered, deformable, and visually ambiguous terrains.

Traversability-annotated points are then extracted and used to derive the left and right boundaries of the traversable path via percentile binning followed by spline or regularized polynomial fitting. These boundaries are then incorporated as soft barrier constraints within an NMPC formulation, enabling safe and adaptive path following in complex natural environments. Rigorous experimental trials carried out in real-life forest environments demonstrate TRACE ability for smooth navigation in cluttered, deformable, and visually ambiguous terrains.

papers.title: Ask About the Right Moment: Training-Free Object Identity Reasoning for Video-Language Models
papers.abstract: Many questions about a video concern one physical object. Where does the ball end up after the cups are shuffled? Which card is the queen? How often was the mug covered? Video-language models (Video-LMs) recognise such objects in single frames but do not keep them apart over time. On real shell-game videos, open models from 8B to 235B parameters, their thinking variants, a reinforcement-learned tool agent and three training-free tool agents all stay within ten points of chance. We separate semantic identity binding from temporal identity maintenance. An object's identity should be fixed at a moment when the evidence for it is visible, and carried afterwards by a tracker. \emph{Track, Then Bind} implements this principle without training. A promptable video tracker follows every candidate object and draws it with a track number. A frozen vision-language model answers a static question about the identifying evidence, which binds the target to a track. The answer is then derived from the tracked state in text, without asking the model to reinterpret the original video during read-out. A single configuration covers all benchmarks. With Qwen3-VL-32B it solves both VET-Bench tasks, where a fine-tuned trajectory model reaches 92\% and 90\% and the same VLM voting over 16 samples stays at 30--32\%. It answers 55.4\% of the hardest Perception Test cup games, where the best published model answers 41.5\%, and, using track-derived timelines, 48.6\% of TOC-Bench questions, against 37.1\% for the same model answering directly. Drawing the same tracks on the video and asking the question directly falls 12--19 points short of the agent on real cup games.

papers.title: CODI: Improving Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Cross Distillation
papers.abstract: Self-supervised Vision Transformers learn strong image-level representations, but their patch-level representations can be unreliable for dense prediction. We study this mismatch and find that the class token concentrates global semantics on a small number of representative patches, while dense prediction errors often occur on low-attention regions. We provide a local gradient analysis showing that, along the [CLS] attention readout, image-level self-distillation gradients are weighted by [CLS]-to-patch attention mass. To provide masked patches with global semantics without changing the architecture, we propose Cross Distillation (CODI), which mixes a small amount of the teacher class-token distribution into each teacher patch-token target. CODI gives every masked patch an attention-independent semantic correction while preserving the standard self-distillation architecture. Experiments on dense and image-level benchmarks show that CODI improves both dense and image-level performance under aligned pretraining settings. Code is available at this https URL .

papers.title: DiffDreamer: Coupling World Models with Differentiable Simulation for Agile Quadrotor Control
papers.abstract: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.

papers.summary_cn: 针对四旋翼穿越动态门、激进跟踪等既需前瞻外部运动又需高频精确控制的任务，论文提出 DiffDreamer——一个把学习到的世界模型与可微分仿真器紧耦合的可微分强化学习框架。其核心设计是在单步优化中让两条前向通路分工：隐空间世界模型负责推演捕捉外部动态与历史依赖特征的隐状态，可微分仿真器负责推演机器人显式物理状态，从而避免模型偏差把环境演化与自身动力学混在同一次 rollout 里。作者还把 actor 目标拆成 critic 驱动的不可微任务奖励通路与仿真器驱动的可微运动奖励通路。实验显示 DiffDreamer 在激进跟踪与动态门竞速上收敛快于 model-free、model-based 和可微分 RL 基线，最终性能也优于这些基线与经典规划控制方法，并给出真机飞行概念验证。

papers.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) introduce unique quantization challenges due to their iterative denoising process. In this work, we reveal that quantization sensitivity is both taskand time-dependent, with different downstream tasks exhibiting distinct precision requirements across denoising steps. We further show that these patterns can be predicted without groundtruth labels or task-specific evaluation metrics. Building on these findings, we introduce T 2Quant, a task and time-aware mixedprecision quantization framework that uses a label-free sensitivity signal to optimally allocate activation precision across denoising steps under a fixed bit-width budget. Extensive experiments across three DLMs and six benchmarks demonstrate that T 2Quant consistently improves the average accuracy of existing quantization methods, achieving gains of up to 6.7 percentage points under the same budget.

papers.title_zh: 不同任务，不同时间步：面向扩散语言模型的时间-任务感知量化
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究扩散语言模型（DLM）迭代去噪过程带来的量化难题，揭示出量化敏感度同时依赖任务与去噪时间步：不同下游任务在各个去噪阶段对精度的需求存在明显差异。作者进一步表明这种敏感度模式无需 ground-truth 标签或任务专属评测指标即可预测。基于该发现提出 T²Quant——一个任务与时间感知的混合精度量化框架，利用无标签敏感度信号，在固定比特预算下跨去噪步最优分配激活精度。在 3 个 DLM 与 6 个基准上的实验显示，T²Quant 能稳定提升现有量化方法的平均精度，同等预算下最高带来 6.7 个百分点的增益。

提出无标签敏感度信号，无需 ground-truth 标注或任务专属评价指标即可预测各任务在各去噪步的精度需求，使量化配置可在无数据标注场景下自动推导。

papers.scenario_cn: 面向扩散语言模型的低比特部署场景，例如显存与算力受限的推理服务中压缩 DLM 权重与激活，在保持多任务精度的同时降低去噪迭代带来的推理成本。

papers.title: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
papers.abstract: Scaling embedding capacity alongside Transformer computation is an emerging trend in language models. This trend makes high compression rates increasingly useful. Hence, we study extreme compression of Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE), which follow this trend and account for 35.2% of the parameters of Gemma 4 E4B. At such rates, conventional quantizers give each token-layer vector its own code of only a few bytes. We instead develop OPTIC (Output-Path-fitted, Token-shared Indexed Codes), which stores one quantized code tuple per token and decodes it at every layer with a layer-specific affine decoder. Codes and decoders are fitted to the PLE output path rather than to the stored vectors. At about $100\times$ PLE compression of bfloat16 (BF16) E4B, OPTIC retains an aggregate 97.8% of the uncompressed model's performance across seven benchmarks, whereas product quantization, the strongest of six conventional baselines, retains 66.3%. At $594\times$ and $1,002\times$ PLE compression of BF16 E4B, OPTIC retains 90.5% and 84.1%. On the official E4B release with 4-bit linear weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16), OPTIC retains 96.9% at about $100\times$ PLE compression. During inference at about $100\times$ PLE compression, BF16 E4B uses 29.7% less GPU memory than with uncompressed PLE at the same key-value cache size, while running at most 0.40% slower.

papers.title_zh: 通过跨层潜在向量量化实现逐层嵌入的极限压缩
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对 Per-Layer Embeddings（PLE）这类占 Gemma 4 E4B 参数量 35.2% 的嵌入结构，研究在极端压缩率下如何避免常规量化器只能给每个 token-layer 向量分配几字节码本所带来的严重精度损失。作者提出 OPTIC（Output-Path-fitted、Token-shared Indexed Codes）：每个 token 只存一份量化码元组，并在每一层用该层专属的仿射解码器还原，且码本与解码器是对 PLE 的输出路径而非存储向量做拟合。在 BF16 E4B 上约 100 倍 PLE 压缩时，OPTIC 在七个基准上保留了未压缩模型 97.8% 的聚合性能，而六个常规基线中最强的乘积量化（PQ）仅保留 66.3%；压缩到 594 倍和 1002 倍时仍分别保留 90.5% 和 84.1%。在官方 4-bit 权重/16-bit 激活（W4A16）的 E4B 发布版上，约 100 倍 PLE 压缩保留 96.9%。
innovations: 提出 OPTIC 压缩框架：对每个 token 只保存一组共享的索引码，跨层复用，再由每层独立的仿射解码器还原该层 PLE 向量，使码本开销随层数增长而被摊薄。
关键的拟合目标设计：码本与解码器直接对 PLE 的输出路径（下游可观测的输出）做拟合，而不是最小化存储向量的重建误差，从而把有限的码字预算分配给对模型输出真正敏感的维度。
在 Gemma 4 E4B 上系统对比六种常规量化基线，约 100 倍压缩下 97.8% vs 乘积量化 66.3% 的聚合保留率，并在 594 倍、1002 倍压缩下仍达 90.5%、84.1%。
在官方 W4A16 量化发布版上验证可叠加性（约 100 倍 PLE 压缩保留 96.9%），并实测推理时 GPU 显存降低 29.7%、相同 KV cache 规模下最多慢 0.40%。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向在显存受限的 GPU 上部署大词表、大嵌入容量语言模型（如 Gemma 4 E4B 这类逐层嵌入结构）的推理服务场景，在几乎不损失基准性能、也不明显拖慢解码速度的前提下把嵌入参数压到原来的百分之一量级，为更长上下文或更大 KV cache 腾出显存。

papers.title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive runs. On the 25-stage task stream of TRACE+17, under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while exhibiting the least forgetting and the strongest retention of general capabilities.

有界内存下的高残差样本保留机制：只把技能无法捕捉的样本写入固定容量的记忆中，用于后续技能修正与蒸馏，而不是无限堆叠上下文。
参数侧的双锚点漂移约束蒸馏：用两个锚点约束递归蒸馏过程中的参数漂移，专门针对长程递归运行中的累积遗忘问题。
构建并采用 TRACE+17 的 25 阶段任务流评测，在固定内存与算力预算下同时报告新任务获取、遗忘程度与通用能力保持三类指标。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于需要长期在线迭代、不断接入新任务而不能回炉重训的智能体或模型服务系统（如持续接入新工具/新领域的企业助手、长期运行的 coding agent），在有限内存和算力预算下既快速学会新技能，又不丢掉已具备的通用能力。

papers.title: Archive coverage constrains abstaining retrieval for transient stability screening more than conditional accuracy
papers.abstract: Power-grid transient stability is assessed by simulating credible faults, but repeating simulations as operating conditions change is costly, motivating faster critical clearing time estimators. Within the AI-ASSIST project, we developed a retrieval-based estimator around three adopted requirements: estimates retain their supporting states, retrieval abstains without compatible support, and support statistics are tested against observed error. Abstention turns estimator uncertainty into a demand on the archive. Exact switching-configuration equality is used. The dense synthetic BUS39 archive covers 99.9996% of 1,044,797 records; the operational ELES archive covers 73.47% of 322,823 records. At query time, 59.37% of ELES states have an earlier same-topology candidate. Under causal availability, retrieval covers 56.34% of records; on records covered under both protocols, mean absolute error increases by 10.0%. No tested support diagnostic ranks first on both grids. Most tested supervised regressors have lower error than retrieval on BUS39, all higher on the matched retrieval-covered ELES population. On ELES, gradient boosting becomes more accurate than retrieval when temporally adjacent states are excluded, so the accuracy trade depends on the archive. Under the adopted compatibility key, archive availability constrains deployment more than conditional accuracy on ELES. Compatible coverage and chronological availability are auditable before an estimator is fitted.

papers.title_zh: 档案覆盖率对暂态稳定筛查中弃答式检索的约束强于条件精度
papers.institution: AI-ASSIST 项目（算例涉及斯洛文尼亚输电运营商 ELES 档案，具体机构未明确披露）
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对电网暂态稳定评估中重复时域仿真代价高昂的问题，在 AI-ASSIST 项目内构建了一个基于检索的临界清除时间（CCT）估计器，并提出三条设计要求：估计结果必须保留其支撑状态，检索不到兼容支撑时必须弃答，支撑统计量要与实际观测误差做检验。作者以精确的开关配置相等作为兼容键，把弃答转化为对档案覆盖率的硬性需求。结果上，密集的合成 BUS39 档案覆盖了 1,044,797 条记录中的 99.9996%，而实际运行的 ELES 档案仅覆盖 322,823 条中的 73.47%；查询时 59.37% 的 ELES 状态存在更早的同拓扑候选，在因果可用性约束下检索只覆盖 56.34% 的记录，且在两种协议都覆盖的记录上平均绝对误差上升了 10.0%。没有任何一种支撑诊断能在两个电网上同时排名第一；BUS39 上多数监督回归器的误差低于检索，而在匹配的检索可覆盖 ELES 人群上则全部更差；ELES 上若排除时间相邻状态，梯度提升反而比检索更准确，说明精度权衡取决于档案本身。结论是：在所选兼容键下，ELES 上档案可用性对部署的约束比条件精度更强，而兼容覆盖率与时间可用性可以在拟合估计器之前就被审计。
innovations: 提出以“无兼容支撑即弃答”为核心的检索式 CCT 估计流程，把估计器不确定性转化为对档案覆盖率的可量化需求，并以精确开关配置相等作为兼容键。
构建双档案对比审计：密集合成 BUS39 档案覆盖 99.9996%（1,044,797 条），实际 ELES 档案覆盖 73.47%（322,823 条），直接量化了可达性能的覆盖上限。
区分“档案覆盖”与“因果/时间可用性”两种协议：因果可用下 ELES 覆盖率降至 56.34%，两种协议共同覆盖的记录 MAE 上升 10.0%，且 59.37% 的 ELES 查询存在更早的同拓扑候选。
发现精度—可用性权衡依赖档案：无支撑诊断在两电网均不排第一；BUS39 上监督回归器优于检索、匹配的 ELES 人群上全部更差；排除时间相邻状态后梯度提升在 ELES 上反超检索。
papers.scenario_cn: 用于电网调度与规划阶段的暂态稳定快速筛查，以带支撑证据、可弃答的检索式 CCT 估计替代大量重复时域故障仿真。适用于运行方式频繁变化、需要在线安全评估并提前审计数据覆盖率的电力系统部署场景。

papers.title: WorldForge V2: Eliciting Camera-Trajectory Alignment in Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. However, their use in spatial tasks is limited by imprecise camera control, spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and entangled camera motion with scene dynamics. Existing approaches, such as task-specific fine-tuning and post-process warping, often introduce visual artifacts, generalize poorly, or incur high computational costs. We propose WorldForge V2 to achieve accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. We first develop a training-free guidance framework using warped references to iteratively refine generation along a target camera path. Optical-flow analysis identifies motion-related latent channels for selective guidance, helping separate motion control from appearance. A dual-path strategy further compares guided and unguided predictions to correct artifacts from imperfect references. Together, these components guide viewpoint changes while preserving scene appearance and object motion. To reduce refinement costs, v-cache approximates the correction using the preceding denoising prediction, avoiding an additional model evaluation. We further extend motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and introduce Trajectory LoRA, which concentrates adaptation on blocks most responsive to trajectory guidance. A two-stage training strategy teaches these adapters to denoise the states encountered during guided generation, using limited supervision effectively. This enables reliable camera control with very little training data, with a single training scene already supporting generalization to unseen scenes. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation.

papers.title: Action Learning for Scientific Simulations
papers.abstract: Understanding and controlling how systems evolve is central to science and engineering, where many problems require reasoning about complete trajectories. Existing approaches typically learn local dynamics or generate trajectories, but objectives constructed from individual transitions can miss dependencies across time, while generative models do not necessarily provide a tractable objective for evaluating and optimizing arbitrary paths. We study $\textit{action learning}$, the problem of recovering a stochastic action from trajectory observations, yielding a common objective for reasoning about dynamical systems. We introduce $\textbf{LEAP}$ ($\textbf{L}$earned $\textbf{E}$nergy on $\textbf{A}$ction $\textbf{P}$aths), which anchors the unknown action to a tractable reference process and learns the remaining correction by comparing observed trajectories with reference trajectories. This construction yields a differentiable objective on path space that can capture both local dynamical structure and nonadditive dependencies across time. Once learned, the same action can be flexibly reused for path ranking and inference, mechanism steering, constrained optimization and sampling. Across stochastic physical systems, many-body orbital dynamics and molecular simulations, LEAP recovers underlying dynamics, captures dependencies across time and enables transfer across inference objectives and physical conditions. We show that $\textit{action learning}$ is a promising framework for turning trajectory observations into reusable objectives for scientific inference and control.

papers.summary_cn: 论文提出并研究“作用量学习”（action learning）问题：从轨迹观测中反推一个随机作用量，从而为动力系统推理提供统一、可复用的目标函数。作者给出 LEAP（Learned Energy on Action Paths），把未知作用量锚定到一个可处理的参考过程上，再通过比较观测轨迹与参考轨迹来学习剩余修正项，由此在路径空间上构造出可微目标，既能表达局部动力学结构，也能捕捉跨时间的非可加依赖——这正是逐 transition 目标与生成式模型所欠缺的。在随机物理系统、多体轨道动力学与分子模拟上，LEAP 成功恢复底层动力学、刻画时间依赖并实现跨推理目标与物理条件的迁移；学到的同一作用量可直接复用于路径排序与推断、机制操控、约束优化与采样。
innovations: 形式化 action learning 问题：把轨迹观测转化为可复用的作用量目标，解决逐 transition 目标丢失跨时间依赖、生成模型缺乏可处理路径评估与优化目标两类缺陷。
提出 LEAP：将未知作用量锚定到可处理参考过程，用观测轨迹与参考轨迹比对学习修正项，在路径空间得到可微目标，同时刻画局部动力学结构与跨时间非可加依赖。

在随机物理系统、多体轨道动力学与分子模拟上验证了动力学恢复、长时间依赖捕捉和跨物理条件迁移能力。

papers.title: Anticipating Social Consequences with Distributional World Models
papers.abstract: Social world models predict how interactions develop after an action, helping agents negotiate, cooperate and mediate. In these situations, one action can lead to several plausible futures, hence predicting only one future can overlook consequential alternatives, while exploring them through repeated simulations increases inference cost. We propose DSWM, a Distributional Social World Model that predicts alternative responses, their probabilities and immediate and final outcome values in one output per candidate action. We train a 4B model on repeated simulations using supervised fine-tuning and GRPO. At inference time, the actor uses these possible consequences to choose an action. Across three seen and two unseen environments, with interaction backbones absent from training collection, DSWM achieves the best average performance on 13 of 15 metrics. Ablations show that retaining multiple futures and their predicted probabilities improves outcomes in all five environments.

papers.title: Comb Tensor Network Finite-Difference Time-Domain Algorithms for 2D and 3D Electromagnetic Simulations
papers.abstract: This paper presents efficient 2D and 3D finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) algorithms augmented by the comb tensor network (CTN) representation of the field and auxiliary quantities. The proposed CTN-FDTD algorithm leverages superior compressibility of CTN compared with quantized tensor train (QTT), and rank-reduction strategies including local and global smoothing techniques to achieve logarithmic memory requirement and computation (per time step) cost. Numerical examples validate these complexities and demonstrate the applicability of CTN-FDTD using a variety of source excitation, frequency and permittivity profiles in both 2D and 3D. Remarkably, CTN-FDTD can simulate 35 trillion spatial grid points in 3D with low memory and computation costs on one computation node, whereas standard FDTD would require 281 TB memory to store each of its 31 3D arrays. Moreover, CTN-FDTD was applied to realistic 2D photonic crystal structure simulation with one million grid points and 3D scattering analysis with 8.6 billion grid points.

papers.title: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
papers.abstract: World models are increasingly used to reduce environment interaction when post-training vision-language-action (VLA) policies with reinforcement learning. Yet they are typically trained to predict pixels one step ahead, even though their role here is not merely to render visually faithful videos but to produce learning signals from imagined rollouts that improve the policy. We show that this mismatch is substantial: lower pixel MSE can produce worse policy gradients, and a world model trained for policy utility can yield better downstream policies despite 17% higher pixel MSE on the next frame. We propose the Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop (DRILL), a bilevel framework that updates the world model to maximize the policy's return after an inner GRPO update on imagined rollouts. DRILL has two instantiations. DRILL-VWI is a closed-form surrogate, requiring no additional simulator rollouts, that reweights prediction errors by policy visitation, the group-relative GRPO advantage, and model confidence. DRILL-IMG is a full meta-gradient method that differentiates through the inner update using truncated Hessian-vector products. We show that DRILL-VWI recovers the local one-step component of the DRILL-IMG meta-gradient under score-compatibility and small-residual assumptions. Across five manipulation simulators and two VLA backbones, DRILL-IMG raises mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World, and complements RLVR pretraining rather than competing with it. More broadly, we believe video world models for VLA reinforcement learning can be productively trained by the policy gradients they produce, not only by pixel-level prediction.

DRILL-VWI：一种闭式代理，按策略访问频次、GRPO 组相对优势与模型置信度重加权预测误差，无需任何额外仿真器交互即可近似元梯度。

papers.title: CRANE: Post-Hoc Counterfactual Retrieval for Multimodal Classifiers
papers.abstract: Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs. Existing explainability methods for multimodal classifiers apply modality-specific attribution independently to each input, which fails to yield coherent explanations and does not transfer to arbitrary pre-trained multimodal architectures. To address these shortcomings, we present CRANE (Counterfactual Retrieval via Agnostic Nearest-neighbour Explanations), the first post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for nearest-neighbour multimodal counterfactual generation that retrieves real training examples from the target class as candidate explanations, ensuring plausibility by construction. Across four heterogeneous datasets and three fusion strategies, we show that Multimodal Consensus Retrieval (MC-R), which intersects per-modality neighbour sets to identify instances jointly close to the query in every modality, emerges as the strongest multimodal strategy, achieving the best or joint-best outcome on three of four datasets while grounding every explanation in the joint training distribution. Unimodal strategies remain competitive when a single modality dominates the decision boundary.

papers.title: Chunk Recomputation under Real Document Revisions: Measuring Update Cost and Retrieval Quality of Fixed, Recursive, and Content-Defined Chunking
papers.abstract: Chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation are almost always evaluated on a static snapshot, yet the documents underlying a knowledge base continue to change. Because chunks are embedded independently, a boundary that moves after an edit forces unchanged text to be re-embedded. We measure this update cost on 120 pairs of adjacent Chinese and English Wikipedia revisions for three stateless chunkers (non-overlapping fixed-size, recursive paragraph-first, and content-defined chunking) under a strict byte-identical reuse rule and a frozen dense encoder. On the 116-article common-success pool, with frozen, length-calibrated parameters, fixed-size chunking recomputes 57-68% of its full new-version embedding-input workload, recursive chunking 38-56%, and content-defined chunking 43-54% (it failed on 4 of 62 Chinese articles), while at these parameters mean evidence recall under a fixed 2048-token retrieval budget differs by less than two percentage points within either language. A cost-only parameter grid shows that the ranking of the two content-aware chunkers changes with chunk-length settings, whereas non-overlapping fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost in every length-matched condition. Controlled edits and a verbatim-presence diagnostic support boundary drift as one contributor to recomputation of text already present in the previous version. Update cost is therefore a substantial, parameter-sensitive dimension that static retrieval evaluations do not expose and that should be reported alongside retrieval quality.

papers.title: Compiling Autoregressive LLM Control into Policy-Exact Parallel Inference for Hierarchical RAG
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Hierarchical RAG is one such setting: at each frontier of a document tree, an LLM commits to $b$ of $k$ sections under an input-dependent action grammar, executed as either failure-prone free-form JSON or reliable but strictly serial grammar-constrained generation. We show that this serialization is unnecessary for bounded-horizon control: the reachable future forms a shallow action-prefix tree, which we compile --- one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe evaluate every prefix-conditioned action distribution with serial decoding's tokens, positions, and causal ancestry. A prefix-state lemma makes compiled control policy-exact in exact arithmetic: the same policy with a two-forward critical path and zero output tokens. One further probe pass certifies the exact order-marginalized MAP set. Across four document-disjoint splits and two scales on the primary MetaX device, compiled control matches the serial policy on $84$--$89\%$ of questions --- every instrumented divergence a floating-point near-tie --- and cuts control latency by $35$--$47\%$ versus token-wise serial decoding and $6$--$7\%$ versus an idealized chunked engine; an H800 repetition preserves the ordering.

papers.summary_cn: 论文针对分层 RAG 中“LLM 控制器”执行效率问题：在文档树的每一层前沿，模型需按输入相关的动作语法从 k 个章节中选定 b 个，现有实现要么用易出错的无约束 JSON 自由解码，要么用可靠但严格串行的语法约束生成。作者指出有界视野控制无需串行化——可达未来构成一棵浅层动作前缀树（action-prefix tree），可用一次根节点 prefill 加一次 tree-causal probe，在与串行解码完全相同的 token、位置和因果祖先下并行评估所有前缀条件动作分布；并给出 prefix-state 引理，证明在精确算术下编译控制与串行策略策略精确等价（策略等价、仅两次前向的关键路径、零输出 token），再用一次额外 probe 认证精确的边缘化排序 MAP 集合。在 MetaX 设备上四个文档不相交划分、两个模型规模下，编译控制与串行策略在 84%–89% 的问题上一致（所有被记录的差异均为浮点近邻平局），控制延迟相比逐 token 串行解码降低 35%–47%，相比理想化的分块引擎仍降低 6%–7%，H800 上的重复实验保持相同排序。
innovations: 提出动作前缀树编译（action-prefix tree compilation）：一次根节点 prefill 加一次 tree-causal probe 即并行得到所有前缀条件下的动作分布，并严格保持与串行解码一致的 token 位置与因果祖先
给出 prefix-state 引理，从理论上证明精确算术下编译控制与串行策略策略精确等价（policy-exact），把关键路径压缩到两次前向、输出 token 数为零
设计额外一次 probe pass 来认证精确的排序边缘化 MAP 集合（order-marginalized MAP），避免用采样近似替代确定性决策
实验覆盖四个文档不相交 split 与两个模型规模：策略一致率 84%–89%，延迟较逐 token 串行解码降 35%–47%、较理想化分块引擎仍降 6%–7%，并在 H800 上复现同一排序
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于以文档树为索引的分层 RAG / 长文档多跳问答服务，尤其是对首 token 延迟敏感的在线检索系统；也可推广到任何有界视野、输入相关动作语法的 LLM 结构化决策流水线（章节选读、工具路由、检索路径选择），用两次前向替代逐 token 串行生成以降低控制开销。

papers.title: Federated Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval. However, real-world knowledge is inherently distributed across multiple organizations rather than being centrally accessible. Privacy constraints further prohibit sharing entire local knowledge graphs, preventing GraphRAG from effectively retrieving and utilizing distributed knowledge. To this end, we propose Federated GraphRAG (FedGRAG), a unified framework for distributed graph retrieval and knowledge-enhanced generation over multiple clients with knowledge graphs. Specifically, we address two fundamental challenges in federated GraphRAG. First, the absence of a global knowledge graph makes unified retrieval impossible. To address this, we develop a Federated Knowledge Routing mechanism that efficiently identifies relevant clients through lightweight knowledge indices without exposing local graph structures. Second, local graph memory cannot be shared directly because it contains sensitive entities and knowledge information. We therefore propose a controlled-disclosure evidence construction method. It extracts retrieved evidence subgraphs and converts them into an evidence abstract, enabling evidence conversion and reconstruction on the server. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Federated GraphRAG consistently outperforms existing baselines in both retrieval and downstream generation tasks, establishing a new paradigm for deploying GraphRAG in federated environments.

papers.title_zh: 联邦图检索增强生成
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出 GraphRAG 依赖集中式知识图谱，而真实知识分散在多个组织、且隐私约束禁止共享完整本地图，使统一检索与知识增强生成无法进行。为此提出 FedGRAG 统一框架，解决两个核心难题：一是没有全局图导致无法统一检索，作者设计联邦知识路由（Federated Knowledge Routing），用轻量知识索引识别相关客户端而不暴露本地图结构；二是本地图记忆含敏感实体与知识不能直接共享，作者提出受控披露的证据构造方法，抽取检索到的证据子图并转换为证据摘要（evidence abstract），使服务器端可以完成证据的转换与重建。实验表明 FedGRAG 在检索与下游生成两类任务上均稳定优于现有基线。
innovations: 提出 FedGRAG 框架，将图检索与知识增强生成统一扩展到多客户端各自持有知识图谱的联邦场景，客户端图谱不出域
设计 Federated Knowledge Routing 联邦知识路由机制，仅依靠轻量知识索引筛选相关客户端，在不暴露本地图结构的前提下完成跨客户端检索
提出受控披露的证据构造方法：抽取证据子图并压缩为 evidence abstract，使证据可在服务器端被转换与重建，避免敏感实体与知识原样外泄
在检索任务与下游生成任务上同时评测，结果一致优于既有集中式与联邦基线，确立了联邦环境部署 GraphRAG 的新范式
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于多机构、多企业数据孤岛下的合规知识问答与检索增强生成，如医疗、金融、政企跨部门知识库：各客户端保留本地图谱与实体，仅向服务器提交路由索引与证据摘要即可协同回答，满足数据不出域与隐私审计要求。
